EO 11541 section 2(b) provides that 'The organizations listed herein are terminated' and names the Council for Urban Affairs (Executive Order No. 11452 of January 23, 1969); section 3 makes EO 11541 effective July 1, 1970, which is earlier than the EO 12553 revocation. EO 11500 (December 12, 1969) only amends section 1(c), and the claim describes that amendment accurately. The 15-clause inventory is complete and contiguous, every span and quote matches, and every clause depending on the Council ending with it is a reasonable reading. Two stated facts are wrong, however. The savings text says EO 11541 contains no saving or continuation wording, but its section 1(b) is a saving clause, although one confined to Bureau of the Budget actions. The scope check says fourteen clauses when the claim and the check's own list contain fifteen. Under the strict-review rule against factual misstatements of sources and internal inconsistencies, the claim is rejected. A corrected version would state that section 1(b) saves only Bureau of the Budget actions and so does not continue any command of EO 11452, and would give the count as fifteen.
